scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:outbox: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d sla -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < etl/sql/outbox.sql
scripts.db:outbox:backfill: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d sla -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < etl/sql/outbox_backfill.sql
scripts.data:drop: cat scripts/drop-data.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d sla
scripts.data:load: pnpm db:up && pnpm data:generate && pnpm app:import
